description: Short real-run smoke for 22_mocov3: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. This is a timm-backed ViT method (ViT-Base), so `needs` lists timm; train.img_size stays divisible by the patch size 16 (64), and train.warmup_epochs is zeroed because the cosine schedule otherwise warms up over many epochs.
